authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2814 karóti gives Prakrit karai, Bengali karā, Assamese kariba and Oriya karibā do/make. The selected Hajong kor/kora/kore/kura and Bengali kɔɾa fit this verb with ordinary final-vowel variation and eastern rounded vowels retained. These are simple verbal responses, not analysed as causatives or multipart constructions. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: kɔɾa.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2854 kártati gives Prakrit kaṭṭai, Nepali kāṭnu, Bengali kāṭā and Hindi kāṭnā cut; Turner explicitly distinguishes the retroflex cutting family from the dental spinning family. The selected bare kaṭ and Bengali kaʈa fit this cutting verb. Source vowel length and ordinary Bengali verbal ending are retained; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: kaʈa.
